blocks.text: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations maintained Sunday the exclusion of Myanmar from the bloc’s key meetings “until there is meaningful progress in the implementation” of a peace plan to cease violence following the 2021 coup in the country. In a statement on Myanmar’s implementation of Asean’s five-point consensus peace initiative, the leaders of the 11-member bloc decided to “pursue a calibrated engagement with Myanmar through a phased and progress-based approach, taking into account developments on the ground.” The grouping’s leaders met earlier in the day under the chairship of Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., with Myanmar represented by a director-general […]...
